property_summary: For any caller and any timestamp, when sending exactly 10 ether to C's fallback the correct contract always accepts (call does not revert) and leaves address(c).balance unchanged only if block.number % 15 == 0 triggers a payout to caller; equivalently, after a successful 10 ether fallback call, either pastBlockTime == block.timestamp and address(c).balance == previous_balance + 10 ether (when block.number % 15 != 0) or pastBlockTime == block.timestamp and address(c).balance == 0 (when block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant that requires 9 ether will revert on some 10 ether inputs and thus violate this universal accept-and-state-update rule.
change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when fallback accepts and updates pastBlockTime.
